title: Forge → NeoForge, proven on DragonMine Z
text: Forge 1.20.1 holds the largest set of mods that never moved to NeoForge, and their players are asked for it. DragonMine Z (Forge 1.20.1, about 960,000 downloads, GPL) shows the cost: a contributor re-ports every release to NeoForge 1.21.1 by hand (its pull requests 265, 269 and 303, the last 760 files). mmt convert takes the mod's Forge source to NeoForge with the rules read from the loaders' own files, as steps 40 and 41 did for Fabric and NeoForge (NeoForge forked from Forge at 1.20.1, so every rename since is in its own history), and the porter carries the result on to 1.21.1. What Forge mods use that the rules lack is listed from the most-downloaded Forge 1.20.1 jars, most-used first, as step 48 does for the bridge. DragonMine Z is the proof mod, in the convert corpus (Forge) and the port corpus (its hand-made NeoForge 1.21.1 port); nothing is made for it alone.
finish: DragonMine Z's Forge 1.20.1 source comes out on NeoForge 1.21.1 with no hand edits, builds, and in the client loads its seven races and 732 items, the same two checks its hand-made port passes (bench/sweep/corpus.json); and the most-downloaded Forge 1.20.1 mods are counted by what the rules still lack
wrongIf: DragonMine Z gets through but the count of Forge mods with nothing missing does not rise, which would mean the rules fit one mod
